title: V-shaped object in the desert turns out to be geese

tellings.quote: can explain like um one of them looked like a V-shaped uh shiny object out in the desert. Turned out it was a flock of geese.

plain: During the Race Across America, a long-distance bicycle race across the country, sometime in the 1980s, he saw what looked like a shiny V-shaped object over the desert, and it turned out to be a flock of geese, says Michael Shermer, a well-known skeptic. He tells it as his own experience, on an episode where he debates UFOs with Michels, to show how ordinary things can look strange.
